items.t: Excessive oil burning on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace pistons and rings with updated parts
items.note: Engine Patrol puts parts near $2,000 and the total at several thousand dollars. A replacement engine runs $10,000 or more if the engine is already damaged.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner (and chain if stretched)
items.note: About $800 for the tensioner alone and about $2,000 with the chain. If the chain has already skipped, engine repairs can reach $6,000 or more.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing, refill coolant
items.note: S5 V6 models cost more because the supercharger or front bumper may need to come off.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on the S5 supercharged V6
items.job: Replace timing chains and tensioners (engine removal)
items.note: Dealers often charge over $5,000; independent shops can be about half that.

items.t: S tronic dual-clutch shifting problems on the S5
items.job: Replace or repair S tronic mechatronic unit
items.note: A mechatronic repair kit is about $800. A full transmission replacement can top $5,000.

items.t: S5 crank pulley breaks apart
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley and drive belts
items.note: Aftermarket pulleys cost less than the Audi part.

items.t: Rocker arm failure on early turbo V6 S5
items.job: Replace rocker arms and rebuild cylinder head
items.note: Dealer quotes can exceed $10,000; independent shops may charge around $5,000.

items.t: Carbon buildup on the intake valves
items.job: Walnut-blast intake valves
items.note: About $500 at an independent shop.

items.t: Crankcase vent (PCV) valve fails and causes leaks
items.job: Replace PCV valve or breather hose
items.note: Quick on four-cylinder and V8 engines; V6 models need the supercharger or turbo removed. A rear main seal leak adds $1,000–$2,000.

items.t: Fuel pump control module overheats
items.job: Replace fuel pump control module
items.note: Module about $250; add about $400 if the fuel pump is also damaged.

items.t: Turbo wastegate rattle and low boost
items.job: Replace boost control or diverter valve, or the turbocharger
items.note: A valve costs $100–$150. A worn wastegate usually means a new turbo at about $1,300 in parts.

items.t: Front control arm bushings wear out
items.job: Replace front control arms and align
items.note: Audi arms run $300–$500 each; aftermarket kits $500–$700.

items.t: Sunroof creaks and rattles
items.job: Replace sunroof frame
items.note: Dealers often fix the noise with padding and re-tightening first, which costs much less.

items.t: Power window stops working or drops
items.job: Replace window motor or regulator
items.note: Aftermarket motors are about $50–$200; Audi parts about $400.
